title: Act: Create backend module, config loader, logger and health router
summary: Implement go.mod, config, example YAML, router, main
description: Create the backend Go module and the config loader with env overrides, slog logger setup, Chi router with /healthz, and main entrypoint.
acceptance_criteria: Config.Load returns populated Config from YAML with env overrides

steps.action: Create module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend with go 1.22 requiring github.com/go-chi/chi/v5 and gopkg.in/yaml.v3
steps.expected: go.mod exists; `go mod tidy` resolves deps

steps.action: Add keys server.addr (":8080"), auth.token_secret ("change-me-32-bytes-minimum"), auth.cookie_name ("sf_session"), auth.token_ttl ("720h"), auth.cookie_secure (true), git.remote_url, git.branch ("main"), git.bot_name, git.bot_email, git.token, hosting.provider, hosting.base_url
steps.expected: File parses as YAML with all listed keys

steps.action: Define Config structs with yaml tags (TokenTTL as time.Duration parsed from string). Implement LoadFS(fsys fs.FS, name string, getenv func(string) string) (*Config, error): read file, yaml.Unmarshal, then override from env STORYFORGE_ADDR, STORYFORGE_TOKEN_SECRET, STORYFORGE_GIT_REMOTE_URL, STORYFORGE_GIT_TOKEN, STORYFORGE_HOSTING_PROVIDER, STORYFORGE_HOSTING_BASE_URL when non-empty; default cookie_name to sf_session and ttl to 720h; return error if token_secret is empty. Implement Load(path string) that calls LoadFS(os.DirFS(filepath.Dir(path)), filepath.Base(path), os.Getenv)
steps.expected: Loader returns overrides and error on empty secret

steps.action: Implement New(cfg *config.Config, log *slog.Logger) http.Handler building chi.NewRouter with a request-logging middleware using log.Info (method, path, status) and GET /healthz writing JSON {"status":"ok"} with Content-Type application/json

Parse -config flag (default configs/config.example.yaml), build slog.NewJSONHandler logger on stdout, call config.Load, then http.ListenAndServe(cfg.Server.Addr, server.New(cfg, logger)); on error log and os.Exit(1)
